findings.claim: The intended entry path is What Is Gurudevi? first, followed by Gurudevi Soul & Core Covenant. Both documents explicitly establish that sequence and both are marked active.

The introduction provides the short human orientation; the Covenant provides the expanded governing definition for product decisions, integrations, agentic capability and implementation boundaries. Their roles are complementary.

The Covenant supersedes overlapping pillar definitions in the introduction and the named earlier manifesto. This is scoped authority over overlapping definitions, not evidence that the entire introduction has been retired.

Preserve active status and the useful purposes of both supplied Core documents. No whole-document archival or superseded status for the introduction is justified. If lifecycle metadata is revised, represent supersession at the pillar-definition scope and retain the introduction as the entry point.

The Covenant was created one day after the introduction, but neither creation dates nor these excerpts establish an implementation timeline. The Covenant expressly distinguishes commitments from shipped capabilities.
The supplied sources contain documentation intent and authority statements, but no implementation or runtime evidence; actual capability delivery cannot be verified.
